# Toysrus HK Avengers Doomsday Collection - Marvel Toys 2026

The highly anticipated Avengers Doomsday collection has arrived at Toysrus Hong Kong. From premium die-cast figures to action figures and playsets, this is the must-have Marvel collection for collectors of all ages.

## Collection Highlights

- **Premium Die-Cast Figures** - Movie-accurate Avengers lineup
- **Action Figures** - Poseable characters with exclusive accessories
- **Playsets** - Replicas of iconic movie scenes
- **Doomsday Exclusive Toys** - Special editions tied to the film
- **Collectible Cards** - Trading card sets featuring new characters

## For Collectors

Limited production runs mean some items will be hard to find once sold. Pre-order the most sought-after pieces early.

**[Shop Avengers Collection](https://www.toysrus.com.hk/zh-hk/marvel-avengers/)**

> New arrivals added regularly - don't miss out!

## 系列亮點

- **精製合金人偶** - 電影級還原的復仇者陣容
- **可動玩具** - 可擺姿勢的角色，附專屬配件
- **場景組裝** - 重現電影經典場景
- **末日博士限定** - 專屬電影版限量款
- **收藏卡牌** - 新角色主題交換卡牌套裝
